title: Building Trustworthy Graph-Agentic RAG for Social Good: Architectures, Failure Propagation, and Assurance by Construction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-agentic retrieval-augmented generation combines structured evidence with adaptive controllers that can plan retrieval, traverse relations, verify intermediate claims, delegate subtasks, and use tools. This combination is useful when answers depend on relations across documents, entities, time, or institutions, but it also creates coupled failure paths: a defect in graph construction can become retrieved evidence, alter later control decisions, and propagate toward a consequential outcome. We examine how such systems should be designed and evaluated for social-good settings in which freshness, authorization, traceability, oversight, and recourse matter alongside answer quality. We organize the literature by graph substrate, graph lifecycle, agent function, coordination pattern, and authority boundary, and distinguish graph-based retrieval from observation-dependent graph control. translated_title: 构建面向社会公益的可信图智能体RAG：架构、故障传播与构造式保障
translated_abstract: 图智能体检索增强生成将结构化证据与自适应控制器相结合，这些控制器能够规划检索、遍历关系、验证中间论断、委派子任务以及使用工具。当答案依赖于跨文档、实体、时间或机构的关系时，这种组合非常有用，但它也会产生耦合的故障路径：图构建中的缺陷可能成为被检索到的证据，改变后续的控制决策，并最终传播至产生重大后果的结果。我们研究了在此类服务于社会公益的场景中，当系统需要在答案质量之外同时关注时效性、授权、可追溯性、监督和救济途径时，应如何设计与评估。我们按照图基底、图生命周期、智能体功能、协调模式和权限边界来组织相关文献，并区分了基于图的检索与依赖观测的图控制。随后，我们将已报告的风险综合为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文系统梳理了面向社会公益场景的图智能体检索增强生成系统的可信架构设计、耦合故障传播机制以及“构造即保障”的质量保证方法。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically organizes trustworthy architectures, coupled failure propagation mechanisms, and assurance-by-construction methods for graph-agentic RAG systems designed for social-good applications.
